summary: Sable Offshore Corp. filed a 424B5 pricing term sheet for a combined offering of 32,467,533 common shares at $3.08 per share and $300 million of 6.5% convertible senior notes due 2031. The offerings are cross-conditioned with new senior secured credit facilities and a term loan refinancing. Net proceeds from common stock are estimated at $92.8 million; combined proceeds will repay existing senior secured term loan and pay fees. J.P. Morgan is the book-running manager. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: execution risk from cross-conditioning.
